verdict.rationale: Exit waterfall modeling is a fair question for an equity and cap table platform like Ledgy, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack mentions exit scenarios, waterfall calculations, liquidation preferences or participation. Cap table reporting and custom views are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
